Hi to desk team,
Clear signage came up late last night, so just a quick note

Thanks for staying sharp on the Companion Animal Travel Desk. A few travelers were asking for extra reassurance about where to go, and the calm, friendly guidance from the welcome team really helped. Please keep the tone warm and practical, and remember that small details, like a clear handoff and a visible path, make a big difference for pets and their people.

For arrival pickup, <<FACT F095>> Please keep the next steps easy to follow for everyone at the counter, and let the companion animal flow stay steady and reassuring. If anything looks off or a traveler seems unsure, flag it early so we can keep the experience smooth.

Also, when an issue needs a faster follow-up, <<FACT F108>> and keep the language simple when you pass the note along. One more thing: <<FACT F101>> so if you are checking a case at the desk, loop that person in without delay. Thanks for keeping the service kind, calm, and attentive for every pet traveler.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
